facts.text: Name's Dodger, kid. Stick with the crew and you eat, but keep your paws off the hot dog cart.
facts.why: Dodger is the one who leads Oliver in raiding Louie's hot dog cart. He would never tell him to keep off it.
facts.fix: Name's Dodger, kid. Stick with the crew and you eat, and the hot dog cart is first on the list.

facts.text: Einstein the Great Dane pulling the cart
facts.why: Einstein is the Great Dane in Fagin's gang, but I could not confirm in a source that he pulls a cart.
facts.fix: Einstein the Great Dane, the gentle giant

vibe.verdict: A good chalkboard barge, but it only uses the hot dog cart and skips the songs and best scenes.
missing: Georgette's bubble bath and 'Perfect Isn't Easy'
Oliver and Dodger stealing hot dogs (the opening chase)
Dodger's 'Why Should I Worry?' street walk
Jenny's birthday at the end with Winston
Roscoe and DeSoto on the subway third rail
ideas: Swap the Dodger note for a safe one: 'Stick with the crew and you eat, kid.'
Swap 'Black cherry soda' for 'Georgette's bubble bath bubbly'.
Add a birthday candle to 'Kitten cookies' for Jenny's party.
